quotes.text: We arrived at Tyre early in tne afternoon, and surely no place can better correspond to the description of it. Formerly insular, it has been connected with the main land since the conqaest of Alexander the Great, and the isthmus is still narrower than the site of the town, notwithstanding the accumulation of centuries. — Of the ancient town not a vestige remains. All is buried beneath the sand,…
it answered by .a groan from Pharaoh, as if an Arab’s shaft had passed through his bosom.
